existing.selection_notes:
• You can prove your academic excellence (GPA equivalent to a Dutch 8).
    • All VUFP applications received by 1 February 2027 (23:59 CET) will be reviewed by the faculty of the applied for Master’s programme.

    Selection
    The selection process considers three main criteria: academic quality of students, the quality of the study program, and the comparison amongst all applicants, maintaining each student’s anonymity.
existing.notes: When applying for VUFP, you automatically also apply for the NL Scholarship. No separate application is necessary. Results expected mid-March 2026.
existing.application_period: You do not need to convert your grades to the Dutch ones. The VUFP Scholarship Committee will do that by deciding on the local grade equivalents for the Dutch grade of an 8.0.
existing.program_type: Students already enrolled in a two-year Master’s programme who have not been awarded the VUFP scholarship in 2025/2026 are not eligible to apply for the VUFP scholarship for 2026/2027.
